name: Samoa
snapshot: A proud Polynesian nation where La'auli Leuatea Schmidt's FAST party won a snap election in 2025 after splitting from the former prime minister.
culture: Fa'a Samoa, the Samoan way, centres on the aiga, extended family, and matai, chiefs who hold family titles and land. Traditional tattoos, pe'a for men and malu for women, are a rite of passage. Church and choir singing are central on Sunday. Rugby players of Samoan heritage star around the world.
society: Remittances from Samoans in New Zealand, Australia and the US are a large share of the economy. Only matai could stand for parliament until reforms, and they still dominate. A 2021 constitutional crisis saw the outgoing prime minister refuse to leave until courts intervened.
baseline: La'auli Leuatea Schmidt, who split from Prime Minister Fiamē Naomi Mata'afa, led FAST to victory in an August 2025 snap election and became prime minister.
